name: dismember_odds
title: How often a kill explodes or severs a limb in the original (2026-10-25; docs/spec-notes/dismemberment.md section 4), over a spread of weapons (every On Hit kind, low to very high damage, a shotgun, energy, a missile; melee could not be driven: FireWeaponEx with a machete killed nothing), head and torso, without and with Bloody Mess. The owner's two sneak kills with Lucky in nvforever both blew apart. On the Searchlight Airport runway save (creatures killed), at 23:00: a Wastelander (WastelanderAM, restrained, its back to the player) is placed north of the player; the player (god mode, first person, Sneak 100, sneaking) is turned to its head or torso every sample and fires once a second (FireWeapon with the equipped weapon; TapControl does nothing while the game is unfocused); level 50 so kills bring no level-up menu (the owner's suggestion; the first run, before it, closed the menus by hook); corpses are disabled after about 1.5 s and the next target placed. Per actor: IsLimbGone 0-14, GetKillingBlowLimb, GetCauseofDeath, the critical stages, and the last hit's JIP flags (critical, fatal, dismembered, exploded, crippled, sneak attack) and damage (GetHitHealthDamage, GetHitLimbDamage). The health before the killing hit is the last sample alive (plugin version 7 has no events). Run sessions one at a time (--only).
